FR-001.title: README Features section near the top, one entry per headline feature

FR-002.title: Screenshots captured from the running product, stored in repo, relative links

FR-004.title: README corrected in place; section order kept

FR-005.title: Seed command creates the demo covering every feature

FR-008.title: Clean removes only the demo group and users; unsafe targets refused

context: constraint: never touch user config or keychain
intent: README Features section with real screenshots generated from a seeded local GitLab demo

decisions.decision: All demo code lives in test/demo/ and reuses GitlabAdmin and the test helpers
decisions.why: XI.4 allows writes to the local instance only from test-only code under test/
decisions.rejected: gitlab/ shell or Rails runner seed

decisions.decision: Demo is the subgroup prwb-demo/acme under a persistent top-level group, plus users demo-reviewer and demo-author
decisions.why: GitLab 19 cannot permanently delete top-level groups; no it- prefix keeps it clear of gitlab:clean
decisions.rejected: top-level demo group, or a subgroup under prwb-it

decisions.decision: Idempotency by find-then-create on fixed keys (path, username, title, source branch, note body)
decisions.why: FR-007/SC-003 need exact zero-creation on rerun without a state file
decisions.rejected: local state file of created ids; reusing GitlabSeeder.begin()

decisions.decision: Split the spec-linked MR from the issue-linked MR
decisions.why: a GitLab issue key (group/project#N) can never match a specs/<folder> name and branch fallback only applies with no key
decisions.rejected: changing spec matching in core (out of scope)

decisions.decision: Run the node:test helpers from a plain script through an after-hooks collector
decisions.why: reuses startWorkbench/useBrowser isolation (temp app data, fake keyring, env restore) unchanged

decisions.decision: Fake AI configured per view; screenshots minted with a short-lived demo-reviewer token; clock pinned to newest MR + 1h
decisions.why: distinct text per MR, no Administrator or real name on screen, stable relative ages
decisions.rejected: one global fake config; root token; default PINNED_NOW which precedes the seed

decisions.decision: Capture writes <file>.tmp and renames only after the ready selector appears
decisions.why: FR-012 keep the previous image and name the view

concerns.note: FR-006 asks for one MR that both references an issue and has a matching spec; the product cannot show both on GitLab, so the plan splits it across two MRs. Spec wording may need a tweak.
plan-blocks.py failed: call-paths.md part is missing; the calls block was written by hand.

plan.summary: Plan: test/demo seed, clean and screenshot commands on local GitLab, eight README feature entries, in-place README fixes
plan.key_finding: A GitLab issue key blocks spec lookup by branch name, so the spec demo MR must carry no issue reference

tasks.summary: 17 tasks after analysis: Setup(1), Foundational(4), US1(2), US2(4), US3(4), Polish(2); labelled against VO-001..VO-013, tdd_check plan and tasks pass

approach: Test-only commands in test/demo/ seed a fixed, idempotent demo under prwb-demo/acme on the local GitLab, then drive the real workbench through the existing test harness (fake claude CLI, temp app data, fake keyring) to capture eight light-theme 1440x900 PNGs into docs/screenshots/. README gains a Features section and in-place corrections; no product code changes.
